full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph shows a lone dark-clothed pedestrian crossing a paved foreground before an immense wall of vertical orange and yellow bands. The wall rises beyond the upper edge and fills almost the entire frame, so its scale is established by the small person near the lower middle. On the left, a broad vermilion strip leads into narrower orange and golden-yellow panels. Fine vertical seams divide these color fields, giving the flat surface a quiet architectural rhythm. A radiant yellow section occupies the center behind the walker, while another hot orange band fills much of the right side. Close to the far right edge, a slim olive-green stripe and a thin yellow line break the warm sequence. The pedestrian moves toward the right in a long dark coat and trousers, carrying a small dark rectangular bag. Their profile is visible but too small for detailed facial features. A narrow black streetlamp stands to the left of the figure; its small flared head is well below the top of the wall. Across the bottom, reddish and gray rectangular paving stones form a shallow horizontal strip, with darker joints and a thin line where ground meets wall. The person's feet and lamp base touch this pavement, giving the graphic color fields a credible ground plane. Bright daylight illuminates the wall evenly, with only slight shifts in tone across the panels; the human silhouette and lamp provide the darkest contrast. There is no visible signage or readable lettering. The photograph is sharply composed yet nearly abstract, its real-world surfaces reduced to large clean rectangles, repeated vertical lines, and a single walking gesture. The overall composition is spare and asymmetric, making saturated warm color and architectural scale feel playful and monumental at once.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑摄影呈现一名深色衣服的独行者，走过铺砖前景，身后是由橙黄竖条组成的巨大墙面。墙体向上越出画边，几乎填满整幅画面；位于下方中部附近的小人物显示了它的尺度。左侧宽阔的朱红条带过渡到较窄的橙色和金黄色墙板。细竖缝把这些色域分开，为平整表面建立安静的建筑节奏。明亮黄色区占据行人身后的中央，另一条热烈橙色覆盖右侧的大部分。靠近最右边，一条纤细橄榄绿与一条细黄线打断暖色序列。行人穿深色长外套和长裤向右行走，提着一个小型深色矩形包。侧面轮廓可见，但人物太小，面部细节无法分辨。行人左侧立着一根窄黑路灯，它微微张开的灯头远低于墙顶。底部的红灰色矩形铺砖形成一道浅浅横带，砖缝较深，地面与墙的交界处有一道细线。行人的脚和路灯底座都接触铺地，使图形般的色域有可信的地面。明亮日光均匀照亮墙面，墙板上只有轻微色调变化；人物剪影与路灯提供最深的对比。画面没有标牌或可读文字。照片构图清晰，却近乎抽象，真实表面被压缩成大片干净矩形、重复竖线和一个行走姿态。整体构图精简且不对称，让饱和暖色与建筑尺度同时显得活泼和宏伟。
style_prompt_en: Architectural color photography turns real surfaces into expansive, almost flat geometric fields. Saturated warm hues sit in adjacent vertical bands, with occasional narrow cooler accents sharpening the sequence. Precise seams and clean boundaries preserve the built scale without loading the frame with detail. A thin darker base grounds the larger color masses, while a tiny dark accent supplies scale and a focal point. Bright even daylight keeps shadows restrained and lets the hue relationships carry most of the drama. Repetition of tall strips creates a measured rhythm, but widths vary enough to prevent mechanical regularity. Generous uninterrupted color makes the image read quickly from a distance; closer inspection reveals slight surface variation and texture. The composition favors a low horizontal anchor beneath a towering plane, with plenty of open area around the small contrasting accent. The overall effect is crisp, playful, and monumental, driven by proportion and color rather than ornate detail.
style_prompt_zh: 建筑彩色摄影把真实表面转化成宽阔、近乎平面的几何色域。饱和暖色相邻排成竖条，偶尔插入狭窄的冷色重音，使序列更锐利。精确接缝与干净边界保留建造尺度，同时不让细节塞满画面。下方一条较暗的窄基底稳定大片色块，极小的深色重音提供尺度与焦点。明亮均匀的日光使阴影克制，让色相关系承担大部分戏剧性。高挑条带的重复形成有节制的节奏，宽度又有变化，避免机械呆板。大片不中断的色彩让图像在远处便容易辨读；靠近看则能发现细微的表面变化和肌理。构图偏向低矮的水平锚点与高耸色面，细小对比重音周围留有大量开放区域。整体效果清脆、活泼而宏伟，由比例和颜色而非繁复细节驱动。
theme_en: A lone pedestrian before an immense wall of orange and yellow bands
theme_zh: 一名独行者走过橙黄条带组成的巨大墙面
name: Yener Torun
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
